verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API reference at docs.segmentapis.com offers a versioned (73.3.0) OpenAPI specification as a direct download. It is backed by documentation on authentication, rate limits, pagination and versioning, plus SDK install guidance. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the downloaded spec is complete and usable, and no evidence of a machine-readable spec for other APIs such as the Profile API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
